name: Lobos Square

name: Funston Playground
note: '1922 Funston. Land transferred by Park Commission to Playground Commission' (Playground Commission history, 1928-29 report); named for Gen. Frederick Funston; 1929 extension on Board of Education land.

name: Moscone Recreation Center
note: Rec & Park Commission Res. 11471 (14 Dec 1978) renamed Funston Playground 'George R. Moscone Playground' after the mayor's assassination (27 Nov 1978); protest by the Marina association Jan 1979 (1979 minutes); 'Moscone Recreation Center' in the minutes from 1981.

name: Margaret S. Hayward Playground

name: Hamilton Square

name: Hamilton Playground

name: Spring Valley Playground
note: Spring Valley Playground on the former Spring Valley School lot (Board of Education permission 1910); still 'Spring Valley' in the 1912-1926 Playground Commission reports.

name: Helen Wills Playground
note: 'Spring Valley, renamed Helen Wills' and 'Helen Wills Playground, when it was Spring Valley' (1928-29 report); rename year estimated = first report using the name.

name: North Beach Playground

name: Joe DiMaggio Playground

name: Folsom Playground

name: Jose Coronado Playground
